title: Web Summit 2025, Lisbon
where: MEO Arena and FIL (Lisbon Exhibition & Congress Centre), Parque das Nações, Lisbon
note: Hand-written, a past edition: AICEP's Portugal Global (12 November 2025, from Jornal Económico) reports the organiser's figures: 71,386 attendees from 157 countries, 1,857 investors from 86 countries and 2,725 startups from 108 countries; it began on the Monday night in Lisbon and ended on the Thursday. Web Summit's own post of 13 November 2025 gives the same figures: https://websummit.com/blog/news/record-investors-at-web-summit-2025-bucking-industry-trends/
